// matmul writer, generated by kohakutt.dsl.metal.
// Change the program's model, not this file.
#include <stdint.h>

#include "api/dataflow/dataflow_api.h"

// Common arguments: out address, mt, per_group, nt, ntot, groups.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto out_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_out = 16;
    const uint32_t out_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t mt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t per_group = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t nt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t ntot = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(4);
    const uint32_t groups = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(5);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t place = core % per_group;
    const uint32_t m0 = (mt * place) / per_group;
    const uint32_t rows = ((mt * (place + 1)) / per_group) - m0;
    const uint32_t n0 = (core / per_group) * nt;
    const uint32_t cols = nt < (ntot - n0) ? nt : ntot - n0;
    const auto out = TensorAccessor(out_args, out_addr, 2048);
    if (core >= groups * per_group) {
        return;
    }
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {
        cb_wait_front(cb_out, nt);
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < cols; ++j) {
            noc_async_write_page(((m0 + m) * ntot) + n0 + j, out, get_read_ptr(cb_out) + j * 2048);
        }
        noc_async_write_barrier();
        cb_pop_front(cb_out, nt);
    }
}
